_comment: Revered Brute Action - Attack (SuperSlam). First ability: TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK gated by ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO + HEALTH_LT_OPP (life check at resolution per release note), effect CROWD_CHEER (routes through effect_crowd_cheers so cheer-counting payoffs see it). Second ability: conditional go again via WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER with SOURCE_IS_ATTACK + HAS_BEEN_CHEERED granting GAIN GO_AGAIN â€” loader.conditional_keywords() strips the printed GoAgain keyword when this ability grants it conditionally. GoAgain and TheCrowdCheers are printed keywords from card DB; not re-authored. Release notes: first ability triggers when card resolves on stack and becomes attacking card against hero; cheer check at resolution. Second ability is a continuous effect always checking; if crowd cheers you after attack but before resolution step, go again applies. No retroactive action point if resolution step passed.
